source: IMEA (Instituto Mato-grossense de Economia Agropecuaria), public PDF bulletins, scraped from https://www.imea.com.br/imea-site/relatorios-mercado
scope_limit: IMEA's own 7-region breakdown, coarser than IBGE's 5-mesorregiao grouping (br_17) and far coarser than the 141-municipio panel; this does NOT calibrate a municipio-level phenology model -- that gap remains open
method: Per season and region, linearly interpolate the calendar day the weekly progress curve first reaches 50% complete, expressed as days after 1-Sep (planting) or 1-Feb (harvest) of that season. One-way ANOVA across regions on this day50 metric, plus Kendall's W on the season-to-season earliness rank as a distribution-free check.
